## Description
Reported Web dialog regression (2026-11-11): **Footer shows a blank strip/gap; Header reads as a narrow band instead of a full stable surface, and scrolling reveals form content around/behind the header**. The intended #3142 three-zone anatomy is not enforced by the shared primitive.

Source-verified on **`staging`**:
- `web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`: `DialogContent` (centered, fullscreen, sheet) owns `overflow-y-auto`. `DialogHeader` is only `flex flex-col gap-2`, with no common opaque full-width header/scroll boundary. `DialogFooter` relies on `-mx-4 -mb-4` and optional `sticky -bottom-4`.
- `web/src/product/{session,project}/components/{AttachDialog,CreateSessionDialog,ProjectDialogs}.tsx` give individual headers their own `sticky top-0 -mx-4 px-4 pb-2 bg-popover`; Project and Session `DialogFooter sticky` often sits **inside the form**. The layout hierarchy is not one enforced Header → scroll Body → Footer.
- Existing `e2e/acceptance/cases/3142/SC-02/verify.spec.ts` tests that **the whole dialog scrolls** (`dialog.scrollHeight > dialog.clientHeight`) and footer background/bottom alignment; it does not prove that only the Body scrolls or that Header coordinates/coverage remain fixed. `web/src/components/ui/__tests__/integration/dialog.test.tsx` asserts class strings (`bg-muted`, `-bottom-4`), not rendered anatomy.
- Existing `docs/design/design-system/patterns/overlay-surfaces.md` already requires a single scrollable Body and stationary opaque Header/Footer. This is an **implementation/verification gap**, not a request for another overlay framework.

**Evidence boundary:** user-observed visuals + source-level causes are established; exact pixel footer gap, bleed, and affected viewport combinations still require measured Chromium reproduction. Do not claim production browser verification from a prototype.

## Reproduction
1. At Web 1440/1180/1024 and constrained-height viewport, open **New Project** or **Project Settings**; add at least 8 Existing Locations or otherwise overflow the form.
2. Scroll from top to middle to bottom, watching Header width/coverage, the close button, first/last field and Footer bottom edge.
3. Repeat in **Create Session** (long Location/ENV list) and **Attach** (long candidate addresses); compare a short **Rename Project** form.
4. Check narrow forced-Web, App sheet/full-height operation/keyboard/safe-area and a nested Select menu. Confirm the surrounding Session/Terminal remains intact.

## Root Cause
The shared Dialog primitive assigns vertical scrolling to the entire Popup rather than a dedicated `DialogBody`. Header/Footer scroll/stick behavior is therefore left to each consumer and compounded by negative padding-margin compensation. A sticky/opaque footer patch (#3128) cannot guarantee the three-zone geometry. The current #3142 acceptance test encodes the wrong scroll owner.

## Impact
Common modal chrome appears inconsistent; form rows can be visible behind an incompletely covering header, footer spacing can look disconnected from the dialog edge, and control positions may shift with scroll. Fix centrally to prevent per-feature layout divergence.

## Fix Direction
1. At the **generic Dialog owner** (`web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`) introduce an explicit `DialogBody` (or equivalent slot) with `min-h-0; overflow-y-auto; overscroll-behavior:contain`. `DialogContent` owns viewport clamp/surface/column layout and **does not itself scroll**. Natural content height for short dialogs; Body takes remaining space only when height constrained.
2. `DialogHeader` and `DialogFooter` become full-width, non-scrolling, opaque surface bands with common border/spacing and close-button placement, no form content visible through or around them. Footer must reach the real bottom edge **without** consumer negative margins or `sticky -bottom-4`; do not add unexplained trailing whitespace.
3. Support **form semantics** with one form owner and the submit action in Footer (HTML `form` attribute or shared composition, no duplicate forms). Header/Body/Footer layout should work even when the Footer logically belongs to a form. Preserve Enter, validation, disabled/busy, cancel/escape, child Select layering/focus and Scroll-to-error.
4. Migrate **Attach, Create Session, Create Project, Project Settings** to the shared anatomy first; then review Rename/Details/Files/Env/AlertDialog, migrating only where the same scroll/anatomy contract applies. Do not alter #3089 Web/App roles, #3137 content recipes or domain operations.
5. App retains its **single Back/header owner**, safe-area and keyboard boundaries. Do not introduce a second header or internal page scroller.
6. Replace/extend class-name-only tests and the misleading #3142 browser assertion with real computed-geometry checks. Do not reopen completed #3128/#3089/#3142; link this regression to their historical evidence.

## Location
- Shared owner: `web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`
- Representative consumers: `web/src/product/session/components/{AttachDialog,CreateSessionDialog}.tsx`; `web/src/product/project/components/ProjectDialogs.tsx`
- Verification owner: `e2e/acceptance/cases/3142/SC-02/verify.spec.ts`, representative App geometry and existing dialog integration specs
- Design owner: `docs/design/design-system/patterns/overlay-surfaces.md` / #3142; #3194 owns broader layout governance, not a second dialog implementation.

## Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 — In short and overflowed production Web dialogs, Header covers the entire dialog's top content band (including close control), has an opaque background and remains visually and geometrically stationary from scroll top/middle/bottom. Body is the **only primary vertical scroll owner**; there is no bleed-through, second form scrollbar or unintended horizontal overflow.
- [x] SC-02 — Production Footer is opaque, visually flush with the surface bottom with **≤1 CSS px geometry deviation** in short and overflowing cases, no blank padding strip or field underpaint. Actions retain submit/cancel semantics, focus, error visibility and keyboard behavior.
- [x] SC-03 — Representative Web 1440/1180/1024 + short-height/narrow forced-Web and App 375/390/430/844×390 + safe-area/keyboard scenarios preserve the applicable dialog/sheet/operation role, one App Back/header, nested popup focus/stack and form draft, with no surprise layout jumps on open/close/resize.
- [x] SC-04 — The **existing** `prototype/overlay-system-3142` mock is revised **in place** to demonstrate the faulty baseline vs approved three-zone geometry (where useful), long/many-rows scroll, Web/App and disabled/error cases. Its own README and gallery entries reflect the new design; pinned orphan source is linked, and publication status + browser verification are recorded honestly.

## Prototype
- **Decision:** Required — explicitly requested in this review.
- **Owner:** existing `overlay-system-3142/` on the shared orphan `prototype` branch; do **not** create a duplicate `<topic>-<this-issue>` prototype.
- **Intent:** compare legacy scrolling entire dialog vs fixed non-scrolling Header/Footer with independently scrolling Body; preserve #3142 cross-family Web/App role decision.
- **Status:** Source revised in place at shared orphan `prototype` commit `6dbcc2a3fad8a0f59b6dc7f4dcb72e832f1f573d`. The trusted Pages manifest binds `overlay-system-3142` to that source SHA, and the published Chromium walkthrough (SC-04 Case) verified the corrected three-zone vs legacy comparison at top/middle/bottom, App, long scrolling and disabled/error states. Production geometry is proven separately by SC-01..SC-03.
- **Immutable mock source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/6dbcc2a3fad8a0f59b6dc7f4dcb72e832f1f573d/overlay-system-3142 ; [interactive entry source](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/6dbcc2a3fad8a0f59b6dc7f4dcb72e832f1f573d/overlay-system-3142/index.html).
- **Verified public HTML at this revision:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/overlay-system-3142/index.html — `prototypes/manifest.json` reports `source.branch=prototype`, `source.sha=6dbcc2a3fad8a0f59b6dc7f4dcb72e832f1f573d`; SC-04 read the live page and geometry report.
- **Fidelity:** Interactive sanitized HTML mock only, separate from production React and browser Acceptance.

## Related / dedupe
- **#3142** overlay semantics / source pattern, previously accepted — current defect violates its scroll owner contract
- **#3128** historical opaque sticky Footer correction — not sufficient for full anatomy
- **#3089** responsive Web/App Session/Project operations — preserve role and width semantics
- **#3137** operation content grammar — keep separate from this shell fix
- **#3194** layout composition Gate — coordinate future enforcement, do not duplicate its scope

## Product alignment
- VISION.md / PRINCIPLE.md: precise, quiet, stable work surface; no new feature or extra visible chrome.
- Minimal shared primitive fix; no transport/API/Session/Project data or new design DSL.

---
**Status:** Implemented; see Acceptance Report and E2E Report for current evidence.
